messages:
elaine: Heads up — ACME (acct 9821) opened a ticket: their dashboard shows ~$1.2k for Feb but their invoice is $3.4k. They say their plan tier on the dashboard stays on Pro but invoice bumped them up mid-close. Can someone take a look?

nina-cs: Filed the support ticket and attached invoice PDF + dashboard screenshot. They say usage spiked only in the last 40m before the cutoff.

mike-billing: I can take it. Do we have invoice id + meter logs? Also did they have any plan change during the window?

elaine: Invoice ID INV-2026-9821, account metadata shows plan=pro throughout. No admin changes in console per audit log. Attaching link to internal billing view: https://console.redwood/internal/invoices/INV-2026-9821

invoice-bot: Invoice INV-2026-9821 generated at 2026-02-01T00:05Z. Billed events sourced from raw-meter-stream partition: invoices/2026/01/31 UTC.

mike-billing: Ok looking at the meter stream — I see a dense cluster of events for 9821 between 23:50 and 00:10 UTC. Many identical payloads but different event_ids.

sam-sre: Can you paste a small sample? Might be client retries or network flaps that we counted twice.

mike-billing: sample rows from bigquery:
```
event_time,event_id,request_id,account_id,tokens
2026-01-31T23:58:12Z,evt_97f7,req_aa1,9821,120
2026-01-31T23:58:13Z,evt_97f8,req_aa1,9821,120
2026-01-31T23:58:14Z,evt_97f9,req_aa1,9821,120
2026-02-01T00:00:03Z,evt_9800,req_bb2,9821,600
2026-02-01T00:00:04Z,evt_9801,req_bb2,9821,600
```
Notes: same request_id repeated, different event_id, some cross the midnight boundary.
```

nina-cs: So dashboard shows deduped counts but invoice uses raw stream? Is that expected? Customer is upset because they say retries are client bug.

mike-billing: Right — dashboard pipeline runs a 5-minute dedupe window keyed by request_id and client_provided_id. But invoice generation pulls from raw-meter-stream with only a short (1sec) dedupe applied during ingestion for performance, and that ingest dedupe is partition-local. If retries cross partition or cross-day boundary they can be counted multiple times.

sam-sre: That's a good hypothesis. I see we checkpoint dedupe-state per UTC-day shard. If events for same request_id arrive at 23:58:13 and then at 00:00:03, they land in different shards and dedupe state isn't shared. So invoice sees both, dashboard deduper (downstream) has a longer state window and catches duplicates.

elaine: So the invoice is technically correct per our billing source, but it double-counted customer retries. Can we offer a credit or do an adjustment?

mike-billing: Recommend manual credit for duplicated tokens that are clearly retries. I can generate an adjustment if CS approves. Need a compact repro and query to compute duplicates.

sam-sre: For future: we should either extend ingest-dedupe to include cross-day keys or ensure partitioning routes identical request_ids to same partition. Quick mitigation: add a 10m post-processor pass for month-end invoices to dedupe by request_id across shard boundaries.

mike-billing: For this account I ran a dedupe query and got ~1,800 duplicated tokens — that explains the ~2.2k delta. Query I used: 
```sql
-- find likely duplicated attempts crossing cutoff
select request_id, count(1) as attempts, sum(tokens) as tokens_total, min(event_time) as first_seen
from `billing.raw_meter_stream`
where account_id = '9821' and event_time between '2026-01-31T23:45:00Z' and '2026-02-01T00:15:00Z'
group by request_id
having count(1) > 1
order by attempts desc
limit 200;
```

nina-cs: I shared that with ACME and proposed a one-time invoice credit for duplicated tokens. They replied: "Thanks, please adjust and confirm future invoices won't repeat." :pray:

elaine: I'll coordinate the credit once finance okays. Finance, FYI — this is a candidate for a discretionary adjustment.

invoice-bot: Adjustment request created: ADJ-2026-9821-01, pending finance approval.

mike-billing: Follow-ups: 1) issue a credit for the duplicated token amount 2) add ticket to infra backlog to fix cross-shard dedupe for month-end pipeline 3) add a doc note in billing FAQ explaining dedupe/window differences so CS can set expectations.

sam-sre: I'll open an infra PR to add the month-end dedupe pass and a test that simulates requests straddling midnight across partitions. Assigning to eng-infra.

nina-cs: ACME confirmed they accept a billing credit and want confirmation when the fix is deployed.

elaine: Great. Closing this Slack thread for primary triage. Will post update when finance approves ADJ-2026-9821-01. :white_check_mark:
